clues.text: Before facing the Philistine, he told Saul the LORD had saved him from a lion and a bear.
He picked five smooth stones from the brook and, sling in hand, went out to meet the Philistine.
As the ark of the LORD came into his city, Saul's daughter Michal saw him leaping and dancing and despised him.
One evening, strolling on the roof of the palace, this king saw a very beautiful woman bathing.
Nathan told this king, "You are that man!" and reminded him that the LORD had delivered him from Saul.
His men urged him to deal with his enemy, but he only crept up and cut off a corner of Saul's robe.
In the days of Saul, his father Jesse was an old Ephrathite from Bethlehem of Judah with eight sons.
